insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Below-Poverty-Line / APL group scheme; Indian resident; treatment in India
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Mental illness, ARMD and genetic disorders 36 months; puberty/menopause and behavioural disorders 24 months

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent 0.5% of SI/day; ICU 1% of SI/day; doctor/surgeon fees 15% of SI per illness; other expenses 15% of SI per illness; total any-one-illness capped at Rs 15,000; total liability Rs 30,000 per family
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Group APL scheme with Rs 30,000 floater SI

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed day care procedures (dialysis, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, eye surgery, lithotripsy, D&C, tonsillectomy)

notable_exclusions_summary: Targeted at APL/BPL groups with Rs 30,000 family floater plus accident death cover Rs 25,000 for earning head. Standard IRDAI exclusions; treatment confined to India; small per-illness Rs 15,000 cap.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospital; reimbursement otherwise. 1-hour pre-authorisation TAT per IRDAI norms.
